test: Mann-Whitney U: transaction amount, fraud vs. legitimate
h0: Fraudulent and legitimate transactions have the same amount distribution.
h1: Fraudulent transactions have a different amount distribution.

test: Chi-square test of independence: fraud vs. transaction country
h0: Fraud incidence is independent of transaction country.
h1: Fraud incidence depends on transaction country.

test: Chi-square test of independence: fraud vs. channel
h0: Fraud incidence is independent of transaction channel.
h1: Fraud incidence depends on transaction channel.

test: One-sided two-proportion z-test: cross-border vs. domestic fraud rate
h0: Cross-border and domestic transactions have equal fraud rates.
h1: Cross-border transactions have a higher fraud rate.

test: Mann-Whitney U (one-sided): 1h transaction velocity, fraud vs. legitimate
h0: Fraud and legitimate transactions have equal 1-hour velocity.
